proof_body:
by
  intro a b hab f hf
  haveI : Fact (0 < b - a) := ⟨sub_pos.mpr hab⟩
  have hba : 0 < b - a := sub_pos.mpr hab
  have hbac : ((b - a : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hba.ne'
  have h := Real.tendsto_integral_exp_smul_cocompact ((Set.Ioc a b).indicator f)
  have hm : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℤ => (n : ℝ) / (b - a)) Filter.cofinite (Filter.cocompact ℝ) := by
    have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℤ => (n : ℝ)) Filter.cofinite (Filter.cocompact ℝ) := Int.tendsto_coe_cofinite
    have hc : ((b - a)⁻¹ : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have h2 := (Homeomorph.mulRight₀ ((b - a)⁻¹ : ℝ) hc).isClosedEmbedding.tendsto_cocompact.comp h1
    refine h2.congr (fun n => ?_)
    simp [div_eq_mul_inv]
  have h3 := (h.comp hm).const_smul (((1 / (b - a) : ℝ)) : ℝ)
  simp only [smul_zero] at h3
  refine h3.congr (fun n => ?_)
  rw [fourierCoeffOn_eq_integral]
  simp only [Function.comp]
  congr 1
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hab.le, ← MeasureTheory.integral_indicator measurableSet_Ioc]
  congr 1
  funext x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ Set.Ioc a b
  · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hx]
    rw [Circle.smul_def, Real.fourierChar_apply, fourier_coe_apply, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    congr 2
    push_cast
    push_cast at hbac
    field_simp
  · simp [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx]
target_source: ∀ (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b) (f : ℝ → ℂ), IntervalIntegrable f MeasureTheory.volume a b → Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℤ => fourierCoeffOn hab f n) Filter.cofinite (nhds 0)
